pages.text: Five vehicles run on electricity: the City EV, Electric Sedan, Electric Pickup, Electric Van and Electric Moped. Their batteries are charged at a $(item)Charging Station$(), in BuildCraft MJ. They don't idle, they need no oil, and braking puts some charge back.

A charging station stores 500,000 MJ, fed by BuildCraft engines or kinesis pipes on either half (or other mods' cables). Park within 6 blocks, right-click it and pay by card or cash for as much charge as you want. A full charge costs far less than a tank of gasoline.
